experiment.classification: Observed digital simulation of an unchanged public EU with a small external origin-token observer. No BIU instance.
experiment.initialization: Lawful partial direct SS writes through declared ports, followed by SS inactive observation. No force, architectural hierarchical writes, ROM replacement or modified EU.
experiment.clock: 50 MHz digital simulation stimulus (#10 ns toggles); nominal 10 MHz CPU opportunities separated by five SYS intervals in the observed sequence. Not achieved physical performance.

cases.expected_rejection: EXPECTED_STALE_TOKEN_FAIL after TOKEN_SENSITIVE_ANCHOR; sole assertion fatal, abnormal exit

experiment.second_byte: The two-mature-byte case represents FA then 90; only FA is supplied/consumed by this standalone EU window. Second byte is not exercised. Queue behavior is declared-port stimulus, not an instantiated BIU or captured data.
experiment.dry_control: Dry EPOP has q_pop offer1, ripe0 and accepted_consume0. An accepted dry CE does not advance or consume.
experiment.pause_control: Four CE0 samples with ripe1 preserve current EPOP25 and both observer tokens; q_pop is an offer, not consumed until CE.
experiment.accepted_control: One accepted mature consume closes the original window from state25 to7/33, observed current boundary0. Correct token0, naive persistent token1.
experiment.simulation_end: Both positives finish at 412 ns, two ns after accepted edge. This does not observe the earliest native +20 ns pin sample.

observer_law.record: Reset/ownedSS clear; otherwise offer sets record, accepted consume or accepted recognition clears correct record. Naive record ignores cancellation. Final st_n is observed oracle only and never drives either record.
observer_law.recognition_limit: accepted_recognition branch is not exercised. Raw bnd_take qualified by CE has not been established as a general recognition-cancellation producer.

observations: Both fixed positive cases satisfy original anchors, dry retention, CE0 retention and accepted consume/cancel.
The fixed negative has original-sensitive correct0/naive1 anchor, then the sole expected stale-token assertion. This is an instrument sensitivity control, not a failing CPU implementation.
inference: An EPOP current-state offer cannot simply be retained as an unqualified persistent request: accepted consumption needs cancellation. The experiment provides one source-local cancellation component, not a complete boundary request producer.
unresolved: ROW/TAIL/OPC/ENTRY request birth and selected context completeness
POSTE/owed-IEND and successor ordering beyond this window
Portable CE/HALF scheduling and SS restore epochs
semantic_limits: Public v30_core.sv:510 drives BUSLOCK_N constant HIGH. No native LOCK pin/hold oracle is instantiated.
No native chip, board, hardware capture, held-out data, Fmax, Quartus, fitter or STA measurement.
No production RTL, QSF, SDC or PLL edits.
No claim that the full staged architecture is implemented or that five-slot publication preserves native waveform.

reproduction.status: Illustrative Linux-style commands, not Linux-tested. Actual execution used Windows MSYS bash, clang and Verilator 5.050; full diagnostics retained.
build_argv: CXX=clang++ LINK='env -u LINK clang++' CFG_LDLIBS_THREADS=-pthread OPT_FAST=-O0 OPT_SLOW=-O0
reproduction.runtime_cwd: Repository root. The simulation module v30u_ucrom sets HEXDIR="hdl/rtl/ucore/" and reads {HEXDIR,"ucdecode.hex"} and {HEXDIR,"ucrom.hex"}; the tables are not root-level ROM files. Use the existing public dependencies without replacement.
reproduction.warning_policy: Wno-fatal retains diagnostics; it does not make arbitrary warnings acceptable. Actual registered baseline diagnostic classes were reviewed: UNUSEDSIGNAL, VARHIDDEN, TIMESCALEMOD, WIDTHEXPAND, BLKSEQ, DECLFILENAME, UNUSEDPARAM, MULTIDRIVEN, PINCONNECTEMPTY, PROCASSINIT. Unlisted warning or new problematic location rejects. Runtime requires compiled assertion/dependency review; expected negative abnormal exit is required, not ordinary success.
reproduction.diagnostic_scope: The actual build retained 96 baseline warnings; this checkpoint does not claim zero warnings. Per-location reviewed diagnostics and instrument errata remain part of its prerequisite closure.
